nodes.label: City of Zamboanga Official Seal
nodes.rationale: Static public asset used as the government branding/logo for the TransactionMS app (likely header, login page, or printed documents).

nodes.label: Local Vite-Bundled Assets (no CDN)
nodes.rationale: Bundled locally so intranet deployments work; downscaled ~480px copies.

nodes.label: Mabuhay! Welcome Greeting
nodes.rationale: Text reads 'Mabuhay! Welcome to the portal. We are delighted to have you here.' - Filipino welcome message for portal visitors.

nodes.label: Philippine Flag Visual Motif
nodes.rationale: Embroidered sun and three stars on white triangle with navy and red silk fields; signals a Philippine government/public-office context for the transaction management system.

nodes.label: Viewer / Guest Portal
nodes.rationale: Filename 'viewer-welcome' indicates this banner is shown to the viewer role (guest document trackers) rather than staff/admin users.

nodes.label: Viewer Welcome Banner Image
nodes.rationale: Hero/welcome graphic shown to viewer (guest) users entering the portal; dark, cinematic Philippine flag backdrop with centered serif greeting text, setting a formal government-portal tone that matches the app's navy theme.

nodes.label: Open Exit Door with Exit Arrow Icon
nodes.norm_label: open exit door with exit arrow icon

nodes.label: Rizal Monument Town Plaza (Philippine city center)
nodes.norm_label: rizal monument town plaza (philippine city center)

nodes.label: Login Screen Local-Identity Backdrop
nodes.rationale: A landscape photo (2016x1512) of a local civic landmark, a white Rizal monument with a clock tower, allegorical statues and cannons, set in a landscaped plaza with a central walkway. Most likely used as the full-bleed background of the login page to give the transaction management system a local government / municipal identity. It is a photograph, not a UI screenshot. The open sky in the upper half leaves room for an overlaid login form.

nodes.label: Sanctum SPA Cookie/Session Auth
nodes.rationale: Uses cookie/session, not bearer tokens.

nodes.label: Default Seeded Accounts (password admin123)
nodes.rationale: Seeder defaults; passwords bcrypt-hashed in DB.

nodes.label: Laravel Framework
nodes.rationale: Stock Laravel skeleton README; not project-specific documentation.

nodes.label: UI-Only Admin Menu Gate (no router role guard)
nodes.norm_label: ui-only admin menu gate (no router role guard)

nodes.label: Duplicate admin.requirements Route Name Quirk
nodes.rationale: Requirements index overwrites workflow-scoped name; navigate by path.

nodes.label: No Router Role Guard Quirk
nodes.rationale: Admin links hidden by UI check only; API still enforces EnsureRole:superadmin.

nodes.label: Generic Roles (admin, clerk, approver, viewer)
nodes.rationale: Scaffolded in RolesSeeder but not wired to seeded workflows.

nodes.label: Forward-Only Routes (is_return_route retired)
nodes.rationale: Going back is a jump to a visited station recorded as Returned; old versions keep their return rows.

nodes.label: Transaction Steps Editor (auto-draft, single Save)
nodes.rationale: Every edit auto-drafts and goes live on Save; version numbers hidden; running transactions stay pinned; deleting occupied steps blocked (422).

nodes.label: Terminal Status Derived from is_end (no status column)
nodes.norm_label: terminal status derived from is_end (no status column)

nodes.label: Pinned Workflow Version Rule
nodes.rationale: All checks use tx.workflow so publishing v2 never moves v1 in-flight transactions.

nodes.label: Finish Transaction Acceptance Criteria
nodes.rationale: Idempotent repeat calls; visible only on final step for authorized actors while unfinished.

nodes.label: transactions.finished_at Column (planned)
nodes.rationale: Nullable timestamp preferred over boolean: null = open, set = finished and exactly when.

nodes.label: JsonLogicEvaluator
nodes.rationale: Null expression passes; invalid/unknown operator fails (fail-closed).

nodes.label: Step Role Gate (step_roles ∩ user.roles)
nodes.rationale: Empty allowed list denies; superadmin bypasses.

nodes.label: Admin Setup Order (Types -> Steps -> Routes -> Fields -> Requirements -> Roles/Users)
nodes.norm_label: admin setup order (types -> steps -> routes -> fields -> requirements -> roles/users)

nodes.label: Roles Admin Screen
nodes.rationale: Role code immutable; superadmin cannot be deleted (422).

nodes.label: Dynamic Field Tables (definitions, per-step pivot, values)
nodes.norm_label: dynamic field tables (definitions, per-step pivot, values)

nodes.label: Live-Editable Requirements
nodes.rationale: Apply to running transactions immediately; delete blocked if checks exist (set inactive instead).

nodes.label: Offices (Archived, hidden from UI)
nodes.rationale: UI removed but tables and API kept live for reversibility; roles alone gate the flow.
